_comment: #347 prototype PEEK -- a finding-pin utility, not a canonical, so it is deliberately NOT registered in qa/manifest.json (the feel_peek_*/*_shot family precedent): the feature it exercises is dev-only and off in every shipped run, so it has no place in the sweep. REQUIRES THE FLAG: run it as `WI_SYSTEM_BESTOWAL_LOG=1 qa/run_qa.sh system_bestowal_peek headless --seed=9` (or pass --system-bestowal-log=1 through run_qa.sh's arg passthrough). With the flag off the wait on system_bestowal_candidate times out BY DESIGN -- that timeout IS the flag-fence proof. Loads the system_bestowal_demo fixture into the leased room already facing the bed, so one interact is the whole route: sleep -> the candidate line -> F3 overlay showing it in the event tail beside the counters that decided it.

steps._comment: Opaque-until-sleep: nothing about the pending recognition exists before the pillow. This asserts the absence, so a future surface leak reds this script.
The whole prototype in one line: the rule that matched, and the counters that decided it. matched:true is asserted structurally -- no OCR.
ZERO player surface is the contract: the sleep resolves as an ordinary quiet night. No class was gained, no level chained, nothing was granted.
